sentences.en: And we started the first episode by talking about Graham Hancock, and I'm sure we'll return to Graham Hancock.
sentences.zh: 我们在第一集开头谈到了格雷厄姆·汉考克，我相信我们还会回到格雷厄姆·汉考克的话题上。

sentences.en: Because Plato comes up with the idea of Atlantis, and as you said last time, it's sort of, you know, people are banding it around for a few centuries,
sentences.zh: 因为柏拉图提出了亚特兰蒂斯的想法，正如你上次所说，这有点，你知道，人们在几个世纪里一直在讨论它，

sentences.en: and many of them don't think Plato means it seriously as a sort of genuine, literal, geographical description.
sentences.zh: 而且他们中的许多人并不认为柏拉图是把它当作一种真实的、字面意义上的地理描述来认真对待的。

sentences.en: But there's a point at which Atlantis disappears from the conversation, isn't there, in the medieval period, and then it reappears.
sentences.zh: 但在中世纪，亚特兰蒂斯从对话中消失了，然后又重新出现，不是吗？

sentences.en: Why do you think it reappears?
sentences.zh: 你认为它为什么会重新出现？

sentences.en: Because, as I say, the myth begins with Plato, and it's Plato who gives us really the two definitive accounts.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我所说，这个神话始于柏拉图，是柏拉图真正给了我们两个决定性的叙述。

sentences.en: But Plato, because he's writing in Greek, his writings are lost, actually, ironically, pretty much apart from the Timaeus,
sentences.zh: 但柏拉图，因为他用希腊语写作，讽刺的是，除了《蒂迈欧篇》，他的著作几乎都失传了，

sentences.en: but almost all his other writings are lost in the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 但他几乎所有其他的著作在中世纪都失传了。

sentences.en: And it's only with the rediscovery of Greek learning in the Renaissance that Plato's dialogues start to reappear in Latin Christendom.
sentences.zh: 直到文艺复兴时期希腊学术的重新发现，柏拉图的对话录才开始在拉丁基督教世界中重新出现。

sentences.en: And this is why, over the course of the 16th century, people become more and more familiar with the idea of Atlantis.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在16世纪的过程中，人们对亚特兰蒂斯的想法变得越来越熟悉。

sentences.en: And the idea of Atlantis that we have at the moment, we think of it as being ancient Greek, but I think it would be better to say that it's at least as modern as it is ancient.
sentences.zh: 我们现在所拥有的亚特兰蒂斯的概念，我们认为它是古希腊的，但我认为最好说它既是现代的也是古代的。

sentences.en: Because as the understanding of it evolves over the centuries since the Renaissance,
sentences.zh: 因为随着文艺复兴以来几个世纪对它的理解不断演变，

sentences.en: it tells us an awful lot about the obsessions and the paranoias and the yearnings of modern Europe and the way that those have evolved over time.
sentences.zh: 它告诉了我们很多关于现代欧洲的痴迷、偏执和渴望，以及这些东西是如何随时间演变的。

sentences.en: And I know I often use this phrase, but it does hold an intriguing mirror up to evolving cultural and political trends in Western Europe.
sentences.zh: 我知道我经常用这个短语，但它确实为西欧不断演变的文化和政治趋势提供了一面引人入胜的镜子。

sentences.en: So, in a way, this episode is not merely a sequel to the episode we did about Plato and Atlantis, but it's also a companion piece to the episodes we did about Columbus, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，这一集不仅是我们关于柏拉图和亚特兰蒂斯那一集的续集，也是我们关于哥伦布那一集的配套篇章，不是吗？

sentences.en: If you haven't listened to our episodes about Christopher Columbus, we did a four-part series.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有听过我们关于克里斯托弗·哥伦布的四集系列节目。

sentences.en: And at the beginning, we talked about how Columbus's head was full of all this stuff that he had read about strange islands out in the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 在开头，我们谈到了哥伦布的脑子里装满了所有他读过的关于大西洋上奇怪岛屿的东西。

sentences.en: Marco Polo, of course, has gone off to Cafe and Columbus has read that.
sentences.zh: 马可·波罗当然去了契丹，哥伦布读过那个。

sentences.en: People are debating if there's a legendary island called Brazil out there somewhere across the North Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 人们正在争论在北大西洋的某个地方是否有一个叫巴西的传奇岛屿。

sentences.en: There might be sort of strange folk memories of Greenland or of Newfoundland, the Viking colony there.
sentences.zh: 可能有一些关于格陵兰岛或纽芬兰岛（那里的维京殖民地）的奇怪民间记忆。

sentences.en: So, do you think Atlantis is revived as part of that sort of package?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为亚特兰蒂斯的复兴是那个组合的一部分吗？

sentences.en: I mean, again, we mentioned this at the end of the last episode.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们上一集结尾也提到了这一点。

sentences.en: So, there are various ways in which Plato's story is reinterpreted.
sentences.zh: 所以，柏拉图的故事有多种解读方式。

sentences.en: And one of the ways in which it's reinterpreted, I think, is a direct result of the discovery of America.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一种解读方式是发现美洲的直接结果。

sentences.zh: 显然，这有问题，因为柏拉图说它沉没了。

sentences.en: Or that there were survivors from Atlantis and they contributed towards the civilizations that people are finding in the new world.
sentences.zh: 或者说有来自亚特兰蒂斯的幸存者，他们为人们在新大陆发现的文明做出了贡献。

sentences.zh: 所以，亚特兰蒂斯是一个先进文明，优于美洲、欧洲、亚洲和非洲人民的想法。
